zh.title: Horizon Aircraft接獲V Star訂單；全尺寸Cavorite X7計畫六至九個月內完成
zh.summary: V Star訂購至多五架Cavorite X7；全尺寸機型計畫六到九個月內完成
body: Horizon Aircraft執行長Brandon Robinson於范堡羅航展表示，公司計畫在未來六至九個月內完成全尺寸Cavorite X7混合動力電動垂直起降（VTOL）飛行器的開發。
Horizon Aircraft在航展期間宣布，澳洲新創公司V Star Powered Lift Aviation已下單訂購最多五架Cavorite X7，並有未來追加95架的選擇權。
Robinson說明，Cavorite X7能以直升機方式起降，配備機翼內12個電動升力風扇，到達一定高度與速度後轉為一般飛機飛行模式，由燃気輪機引擎執行。

en.title: Horizon Aircraft wins Cavorite X7 order from V Star; full-scale aircraft expected in six to nine months
en.summary: Horizon Aircraft announces V Star order for up to five Cavorite X7s; full-scale aircraft expected in six to nine months
body: Horizon Aircraft CEO Brandon Robinson stated at the Farnborough Airshow that the company expects to complete a full-scale Cavorite X7 within the next six to nine months, following the completion of a half-scale model.

Horizon Aircraft announced that Australia-based startup V Star Powered Lift Aviation has placed an order for up to five Cavorite X7 hybrid electric vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) aircraft, with an option for 95 more in the future.
The Cavorite X7 takes off like a helicopter using 12 electrically powered lift fans in its wing, then covers the fans and flies like a plane using a gas-turbine engine, according to Horizon.

zh.title: IATA 2026年世界安全與營運研討會將於伊斯坦堡登場
zh.summary: IATA宣布2026年WSOC研討會以人為本；10月6至8日登場
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）宣布，2026年世界安全與營運研討會（WSOC）將以「Performance Through People」為主題，聚焦於人在維持航空安全與韌性中所扮演的角色。這項會議由土耳其航空主辦，預定於10月6日至8日在土耳其伊斯坦堡舉行。
IATA資深副總裁（營運、安全與保安）Nick Careen表示：「隨著科技、數據、AI與自動化改變航空業管理風險的方式，今年度的WSOC將聚焦於每天運用這些工具、在面對突發狀況時做出關鍵決策的人員。」他也指出，與會人員需要具備適當的技能與支持，才能妥善運用各項投資中的科技，而WSOC正是讓安全專業人士交流經驗與相互學習的場合。
除了瑞士日內瓦總部釋出的這項訊息，IATA也公開了多位與談講者名單，包括IATA安全總監Mark Searle、土耳其航空執行長暨執行委員Ahmet Olmuştur、歐洲聯盟航空安全總署（EASA）執行長Florian Guillermet、美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）航空安全副局長助理與波音（Boeing）資深副總裁暨首席航空安全官Don Ruhmann等人。
本次研討會規劃有安全、客艙作業、營運與危機管理等四大主題，並安排包括「地緣政治風險對人員表現的影響」「以人為中心的安全：人員因素實務」「對齊風險承受度與人員表現的迴旋餘地」「提升未來航空安全人才」等重點場次。
此外，WSOC也將結合多場工作坊與專業論壇，內容涵蓋安全管理與人因、空域效率與韌性、安全資料分析（GDAM）、應變計畫規劃論壇，以及IATA「飛行中難預測氣象（Turbulence Aware）」專區討論。大會並開放經認證的媒體記者現場採訪。

en.title: IATA announces 2026 World Safety and Operations Conference in Istanbul, focused on human performance
en.summary: IATA says 2026 WSOC in Istanbul, Oct 6-8, will focus on human elements in aviation safety.
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) has announced that its 2026 World Safety and Operations Conference (WSOC) will focus on the human elements in keeping aviation safe and resilient, under the theme “Performance Through People”. The event is scheduled to take place from 6 to 8 October in Istanbul, Türkiye, and will be hosted by Turkish Airlines.

“As technology, data, AI, and automation transform how aviation manages risk, this year’s WSOC will focus on the people who use these tools every day to make critical decisions in response to disruption, to manage daily operations, or improve processes and ways of working,” said Nick Careen, IATA’s Senior Vice President for Operations, Safety and Security. He added that the conference brings safety professionals together to share experience and learn from one another.

In addition to Careen and IATA’s Director of Safety Mark Searle, the announced speakers include Turkish Airlines CEO Ahmet Olmuştur, EASA Executive Director Florian Guillermet, FAA Deputy Associate Administrator for Aviation Safety Jodi Baker, and Boeing’s Senior Vice President and Chief Aerospace Safety Officer Don Ruhmann, among others.

The conference program will feature four tracks—Safety, Cabin Operations, Operations, and Crisis Management—with highlights such as geopolitical risk and its impact on performance, human-centred safety, aligning risk appetite with human performance, and future-proofing aviation safety talent.

The WSOC will also include workshops and forums covering safety management and human factors, airspace efficiency and resilience, advancing safety insights with GADM, emergency response planning, and an IATA Turbulence Aware forum. The conference is open to accredited members of the press.

zh.title: 埃及航空擬開羅經新加坡至雪梨航線
zh.summary: 埃及航空規劃2027年開航；開羅經新加坡至雪梨；尚待監管批准
body: 埃及航空宣布計畫於2027年開辦經新加坡往返開羅與雪梨的一站式服務，該計畫仍待監管機關批准。
根據雪梨機場（SYD）說法，這將是新加坡與澳洲首條通往北非的直飛航線；航線宣布於埃及的埃爾阿拉曼航空展（El Alamein Air Show）進行。
埃及航空董事長兼執行長艾哈邁德·阿德爾（Captain Ahmed Adel）表示，與雪梨機場的夥伴關係是擴展國際網路的重要一步。
該航線可能使用空中巴士A350機型機隊營運；進一步的時刻表、機型和售票細節預計於接近2027年開航時公布。

en.title: EgyptAir plans Sydney service via Singapore-Sydney from 2027
en.summary: EgyptAir plans a one-stop Cairo-Singapore-Sydney route from 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.
body: EgyptAir has announced plans to launch a one-stop service from Cairo to Sydney via Singapore from 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.

Sydney Airport (SYD) said Egypt would be the largest unserved African market for Australian travellers; the airline's service would be a first direct link to North Africa for both Singapore and Australia.
EgyptAir chairman and CEO Captain Ahmed Adel said the partnership with Sydney Airport was an important step in growing the airline's network.
The route may be served by the carrier's new Airbus A350 aircraft, and further details on timetable, aircraft type and ticket sales are expected closer to the planned 2027 launch.
